name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Reveal related sections while keeping their headings easy to scan.

## Installation ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/accordion ``` ## Usage The trigger includes a level-three heading. Place the accordion under a meaningful level-two section heading, such as the component questions in the preview. ```tsx import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function Example() { return ( When will my order arrive? Most orders arrive within five working days. ); } ``` ## Controlled Base UI uses arrays for both single and multiple selection. The caller owns the value; these external actions open or close the account section without resetting other examples. ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function ControlledExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState([]); return
Account settings Your account details stay with the caller.

Open sections: {value.join(", ") || "none"}

; } ``` ## Multiple sections Set multiple to keep several answers open. Both start open here; closing Delivery leaves Returns unchanged. ```tsx import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function MultipleExample() { return DeliveryTrack your delivery from your order history. ReturnsStart a return within thirty days. ; } ``` ## Disabled An item can be unavailable while its neighbours remain usable. Root disabled applies to every trigger. Disabled triggers cannot activate and are skipped by Tab; initially open information can still be read. ```tsx import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function DisabledExample() { return
Available settingsYou can edit these settings. Unavailable sectionNot available yet. Settings helpContact the workspace owner. Read-only summaryThe whole group is disabled; this initial summary remains readable. Locked next stepUnavailable.
; } ``` ## Persistent content Closed panels normally unmount. Root keepMounted preserves the native input and its draft while hidden; the second group applies keepMounted to one panel instead. Each input has an independent label and ID. Hidden controls leave the tab order. ```tsx "use client"; import { useId } from "react"; import { Input } from "@/components/cadence/input"; import { Label } from "@/components/cadence/label"; import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function PersistentExample() { const rootId = useId(); const panelId = useId(); return
Workspace draft Panel draft
; } ``` ## Searchable content hiddenUntilFound keeps a closed panel in the DOM with hidden="until-found", overriding keepMounted. In supporting browsers, search for “Cobalt delivery reference” using the browser’s Find command to reveal it. The second group applies the same option to one panel. Browser support and native find behavior remain browser responsibilities. ```tsx import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function SearchableExample() { return
Delivery referenceCobalt delivery reference: use your order number when contacting support. Searchable policyIndigo returns reference: keep your receipt for a return.
; } ``` ## Changing content This caller-owned action inserts real detail into an open answer. Full mode follows the measured height and can reverse while opening or closing; reduced and none update height immediately. The section’s own trigger still controls disclosure. ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/cadence/button"; import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function ChangingContentExample() { const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false); return Can I reduce the motion?

Yes. Your system preference is respected, and the provider can disable motion entirely.

Disclosure heights update instantly in reduced and none modes. Full mode follows the measured content height and can reverse while moving.

} ; } ``` ## Custom panel rendering Use render to change the panel’s element while preserving the supplied children, props and ref. className styles the inner content; style applies to the outer measured panel. The existing trigger and heading remain native accessible controls. ```tsx import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function CustomRenderExample() { return Where can I get help? } className="text-muted-foreground" style={{ scrollMarginTop: "6rem" }}> Read the installation guide before adding your first component. ; } ``` ## Legacy orientation vertical and horizontal are deprecated Base UI state values, shown separately below. Cadence retains a vertical layout for both; these props and loopFocus do not enable arrow-key roving focus. Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between triggers. ```tsx import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function OrientationExample() { return
{(["vertical", "horizontal"] as const).map(orientation => {orientation} stateOrientation is retained as state; keyboard navigation follows normal Tab order. Next {orientation} sectionThis is still a vertically stacked section. )}
; } ``` ## Without motion The first accordion has an explicit none provider from its first render. A nested full provider opts the second accordion back into the normal geometry recipe. The operating system’s reduced-motion preference still takes priority over full. ```tsx "use client"; import { CadenceProvider } from "@/components/cadence/lib/provider"; import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/cadence/accordion"; export function WithoutMotionExample() { return
Instant disclosureNo height transition runs here. Nested full disclosureThe operating system can still reduce this transition.
; } ``` ## When to use - FAQ answers that readers scan by heading. - Related settings sections with optional detail. - Compact reference material with meaningful section titles. ## When not to use - Use Collapsible for a single disclosure without grouped navigation. - Use Tabs for peer views occupying one shared panel. - Keep essential instructions visible rather than hiding them. ## API ### `Accordion` | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `value` / `defaultValue` | `Value[]` | uncontrolled / `[]` | Expanded item values. | | `onValueChange` | `(value, details) => void` | — | Caller-owned controlled state. | | `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Permit several expanded items. | | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable all items. | | `orientation` | `"vertical" | "horizontal"` | `"vertical"` | Deprecated; retained as state only. | | `keepMounted` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep closed panels in the DOM. | | `hiddenUntilFound` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow browser find-in-page to reveal content. | ### `AccordionItem` | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `value` | `unknown` | generated | Stable identity for controlled state. | | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable this item's trigger. | ### `AccordionTrigger` All Base UI Trigger props pass through, including `render`, `ref`, and `nativeButton`. A heading wraps the trigger. Two decorative icons swap immediately with `aria-expanded`; no rotation is animated. ### `AccordionContent` All Base UI Panel props pass through, including `keepMounted`, `hiddenUntilFound`, `render`, `style`, and `ref`. `className` styles the inner content, matching upstream; `style` applies to the panel. Root and Item classes merge last. ## Motion contract | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Open / close / content resize | Measured height clamped at zero | `geometry.resize` CSS form: `duration.slow` / `ease.out` | Yes, native CSS reversal from current height | | Initially open | Natural height, no entrance | — | — | | Reduced | Instant height, no transform | Zero duration | Yes | | None | Instant height, no transform or transition | Zero duration | Yes | The CSS form preserves position on interruption rather than spring velocity. Base UI owns panel mounting, hidden state, keyboard navigation, and find-in-page behavior. An inner ResizeObserver retargets changes in content without observing the animated panel itself. The closed size is zero. ## Accessibility Triggers expose expanded state and control labelled regions. Focus stays on the trigger when a panel toggles. Give each trigger a meaningful heading; do not place interactive controls inside it. Disabled items are skipped in tab navigation. Content controls remain in normal tab order. ## Keyboard interactions | Keys | Action | | --- | --- | | Enter / Space | Toggle the focused trigger. | | Tab / Shift+Tab | Follow normal page order through triggers and open content. | Base UI 1.6 follows the updated APG guidance without arrow-key roving focus. `orientation` and `loopFocus` are deprecated passthrough props; neither changes keyboard focus behavior. ## Responsive behavior The root fills its container. Long headings wrap and the icons retain their size. Content is remeasured when wrapping changes; there is no fixed maximum height or breakpoint-specific state. ## Performance T3 budget: 12 KB gzip. One observer per mounted content slot; closed panels unmount by default. Measurements run after commit and on content resize, never during render. No timers drive motion. Server-rendered initially open content keeps its natural size before hydration. ## Notes for AI - Use the Base UI array value API, not Radix `type="single"` or `collapsible` props. - Preserve all four exports and the trigger-icon slot when customising. - Keep the measurement wrapper and mode branch when editing motion. - Related: Collapsible for a standalone disclosure; Tabs for alternate views.
